---
title: "03 — Q2: reference database and simplification"
author: "Adrien Taudière"
---

Effect of the reference database and of its simplification (`config.R`:
the whole release, its Fungi-only records, and Fungi plus non-fungal
representatives `_Fungi_rep`; the primer-trimmed `fungi + rep cut` belongs to
the final zoom, Q2.6). Figures: Q2.1 (per-DB accuracy), Q2.2 (paired
simplification effect), Q2.5 (DB size vs compute cost and accuracy), Q2.6
(trimmed references, Pauvert only).

Every section has one tab per mock and ITSx region (`analysis_views()` in
`00_setup.R`), on the ASVs: Pauvert ITS1, then Tedersoo ITS1, ITS2 and full.
The figures are saved once per view, suffixed with it. The costs of Q2.5 come
from each dataset's own assignment store (`costs_for()`).

F1 and PPV are scored on the real units only; ACC and MCC keep the
controls in the matrix, the TN cell being theirs (OD 49). The controls report
through their own rates, in a table under the summary.

```{r setup}
here::i_am("analysis/03_q2_databases.qmd")  # _quarto.yml would otherwise make here() root = analysis/
source(here::here("analysis/00_setup.R"))
res_all <- cache_read("res_comp_tax")
views <- analysis_views(res_all)

# Default settings (bootstrap 0.5 / rel_majority), with the simplification
# step of each database.
q2_base <- function(res) {
  res |>
    filter(metrics %in% c("F1_score", "MCC")) |>
    filter_default_settings() |>
    left_join(db_meta, by = "db") |>
    mutate(
      tax_level      = factor(tax_level,      levels = tax_order),
      simplification = factor(simplification, levels = unique(db_meta$simplification))
    )
}
```

## Summary

```{r summary-data}
#| include: false
# Computed from the same views and filters as the tabs below.
s03_genus <- view_rows(res_all, views) |>
  filter(metrics == "F1_score", tax_level == "Genus") |>
  filter_default_settings() |>
  left_join(db_meta, by = "db")
s03_by_db <- s03_genus |>
  group_by(view, db, db_base, simplification) |>
  summarise(value = mean(values), .groups = "drop")
s03_spread_db <- s03_by_db |>
  group_by(view) |>
  summarise(spread = max(value) - min(value), .groups = "drop")
s03_spread_algo <- s03_genus |>
  group_by(view, algo) |>
  summarise(value = mean(values), .groups = "drop") |>
  group_by(view) |>
  summarise(spread = max(value) - min(value), .groups = "drop")
s03_by_source <- s03_by_db |>
  group_by(view, db_base) |>
  summarise(value = mean(value), .groups = "drop") |>
  rename(source = db_base)
# Paired steps within a source, per method: full -> Fungi, Fungi -> Fungi+rep.
s03_steps <- s03_genus |>
  select(view, algo, db_base, simplification, values) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = simplification, values_from = values) |>
  transmute(
    view, algo, db_base,
    `full → Fungi` = Fungi - full,
    `Fungi → Fungi+rep` = `Fungi+rep` - Fungi
  ) |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(c(`full → Fungi`, `Fungi → Fungi+rep`), names_to = "step", values_to = "delta")
s03_step_mean <- s03_steps |>
  group_by(view, step) |>
  summarise(delta = mean(delta), .groups = "drop")
s03_db_word <- if (all(s03_spread_db$spread < s03_spread_algo$spread)) {
  "smaller than the spread between methods in every view (Q1)"
} else {
  "not always smaller than the spread between methods (Q1)"
}
# Paired intervals (OD 50), per view, on the same units: each step of the
# ladder (mean over the sources and methods) and EUKARYOME against each UNITE
# release (mean over the variants and methods).
s03_cells <- read_cells()
s03_intervals <- bind_rows(lapply(seq_len(nrow(views)), function(i) {
  cells <- s03_cells |>
    filter(
      dataset == views$dataset[i], region == views$region[i],
      unit == "ASV", !is_consensus
    ) |>
    mutate(column = method_db, unit_id = taxon, group = taxon)
  cols <- distinct(cells, column, db_base, simplification)
  pick <- \(keep) cols$column[keep]
  euk <- grepl("^EUK", cols$db_base)
  unite <- setdiff(unique(cols$db_base[!euk]), NA)
  contrasts <- c(
    list(
      list(
        label = "full → Fungi",
        a = pick(cols$simplification == "Fungi"),
        b = pick(cols$simplification == "full")
      ),
      list(
        label = "Fungi → Fungi+rep",
        a = pick(cols$simplification == "Fungi+rep"),
        b = pick(cols$simplification == "Fungi")
      )
    ),
    lapply(unite, \(u) {
      list(label = paste0("EUKARYOME − ", u), a = pick(euk), b = pick(cols$db_base == u))
    })
  )
  boot_contrasts(boot_view(cells), contrasts) |>
    mutate(view = views$label[i])
}))
s03_iv_f1 <- filter(s03_intervals, metric == "F1")
s03_iv_phrase <- s03_iv_f1 |>
  group_by(contrast) |>
  group_map(\(tbl, key) paste0(key$contrast, " ", excludes_zero(tbl))) |>
  unlist() |>
  paste(collapse = "; ")
s03_controls <- view_rows(res_all, views) |>
  filter_default_settings() |>
  left_join(db_meta, by = "db") |>
  controls_beside("simplification")
```

Default settings, ASVs, Genus F1 averaged over the four methods; one value
per view.

- **Best database**: `r best_phrase(s03_by_db, "db")`. Best minus worst
  database `r fmt_range(s03_spread_db$spread)` per view, `r s03_db_word`
  (`r fmt_range(s03_spread_algo$spread)`).
- **Best source** (mean of its three variants): `r best_phrase(s03_by_source, "source")`.
- **Simplification**, paired within a source, mean over sources and methods:
  full → Fungi `r fmt_range(s03_step_mean$delta[s03_step_mean$step == "full → Fungi"])`,
  Fungi → Fungi+rep `r fmt_range(s03_step_mean$delta[s03_step_mean$step == "Fungi → Fungi+rep"])`
  across the views.
- **Paired intervals** (OD 50, Genus F1, 95 % bootstrap over the units,
  table in Q2.2): the interval excludes 0 for `r s03_iv_phrase`.
- **Controls** (OD 49): the F1 above is scored on the real units only; with
  the controls in the matrix it is lower by
  `r fmt_range(s03_controls$shift)` (simplification means per view, table
  below), most on the Fungi-only databases, where a named external control
  is an error.

## Q2.1 — Per-DB accuracy

Default settings (bootstrap 0.5 / rel_majority). `db_meta` (which
simplification step each DB represents) comes from `config.R`.

```{r q2-1, results = "asis"}
view_tabs(res_all, views, function(res, v) {
  fig_q2_db <- q2_base(res) |>
    ggplot(aes(x = db, y = values, fill = simplification)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge()) +
    facet_grid(metrics + algo ~ tax_level) +
    labs(x = "Database", y = "Value", fill = "Simplification") +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 55, hjust = 1))
  print(fig_q2_db)
  save_fig(fig_q2_db, paste0("fig_q2_db_", v$id), width = 18, height = 14)
})
```

## Q2.2 — Simplification effect (paired Δ F1/MCC)

Paired comparisons within each source release: full → Fungi and
Fungi → Fungi+rep, derived from `db_meta` in `config.R`, so they follow the
databases actually benchmarked.

```{r q2-2, results = "asis"}
# Signed delta (simplified − full) for one pair of databases.
db_pair_delta <- function(data, db_full, db_simp, label) {
  data |>
    filter(db %in% c(db_full, db_simp)) |>
    select(algo, tax_level, metrics, db, values) |>
    pivot_wider(names_from = db, values_from = values) |>
    mutate(
      delta      = .data[[db_simp]] - .data[[db_full]],
      comparison = label
    ) |>
    select(algo, tax_level, metrics, comparison, delta)
}

# Pairs (from -> to) of simplification steps within the same source.
pair_steps <- function(from, to) {
  inner_join(
    filter(db_meta, simplification == from),
    filter(db_meta, simplification == to),
    by = "db_base",
    suffix = c("_full", "_simp")
  ) |>
    transmute(db_full, db_simp, label = paste0(db_base, ": ", from, " → ", to))
}

db_pairs <- bind_rows(pair_steps("full", "Fungi"), pair_steps("Fungi", "Fungi+rep"))

view_tabs(res_all, views, function(res, v) {
  base <- q2_base(res)
  tab_q2_simplif <- purrr::pmap(
    db_pairs,
    \(db_full, db_simp, label) db_pair_delta(base, db_full, db_simp, label)
  ) |>
    bind_rows() |>
    mutate(tax_level = factor(tax_level, levels = tax_order))

  tab_q2_simplif |>
    group_by(comparison, algo, metrics, tax_level) |>
    summarise(delta_mean = round(mean(delta, na.rm = TRUE), 3), .groups = "drop") |>
    pivot_wider(names_from = tax_level, values_from = delta_mean) |>
    arrange(comparison, metrics, algo) |>
    cat_kable(caption = "Δ F1/MCC (simplified − full). Positive = simplification helps.")

  fig_q2_simplif <- tab_q2_simplif |>
    ggplot(aes(x = algo, y = delta, fill = comparison)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.4, linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge()) +
    facet_grid(metrics ~ tax_level) +
    labs(x = "Method", y = "Δ (simplified − full)", fill = "Comparison") +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
  print(fig_q2_simplif)
  save_fig(fig_q2_simplif, paste0("fig_q2_simplification_", v$id), width = 18, height = 8)
})
```

Paired intervals of the summary's differences (OD 50), every view: each
step of the ladder (mean over the sources and methods) and EUKARYOME against
each UNITE release (mean over the database variants and methods), default
settings, ASVs. A draw resamples the scored real units, and every column is
scored again on it.

```{r q2-2-intervals, results = "asis"}
#| echo: false
cat_intervals(s03_intervals, "Paired differences of Genus F1 and PPV, ASVs, default settings.")
```

## Q2.5 — DB size vs compute cost and accuracy

Does a smaller (filtered / trimmed) DB pay for itself in runtime without
losing F1? Uses `benchmark_costs` (see `05_m2_costs.qmd` for its provenance),
restricted to the computations of the view's region. One point per
computation (method × database): the rows of one computation share its cost,
so averaging rows would weight blastn by its 12 rows (code review §1.5). The
size is that of the sintax-format file for every method (the dada2 file holds
the same records). F1 at Genus, the primary endpoint (OD 43).

```{r q2-5, results = "asis"}
view_tabs(res_all, views, function(res, v) {
  db_size <- tibble(
    db = db_list,
    db_size_mb = file.size(here(db_path_for("sintax", db_list))) / 1e6
  )
  cost_tbl <- costs_for(v$dataset, res) |>
    filter(phase %in% res$method_db, !startsWith(db, "mini_")) |>
    distinct(compute_name, method, db, wall_time_s) |>
    left_join(db_size, by = "db")

  f1_by_db <- res |>
    filter(metrics == "F1_score", tax_level == "Genus") |>
    filter_default_settings() |>
    group_by(algo, db) |>
    summarise(f1 = mean(values, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

  q2_5_data <- cost_tbl |>
    left_join(f1_by_db, by = c("method" = "algo", "db")) |>
    left_join(db_meta |> select(db, db_base, simplification), by = "db")

  p_size_time <- q2_5_data |>
    ggplot(aes(x = db_size_mb, y = wall_time_s / 60, colour = method, shape = db_base)) +
    geom_point(size = 2.5) +
    scale_x_log10() +
    scale_y_log10() +
    labs(
      x = "DB size (MB, sintax file)",
      y = "Wall time of one computation (min)",
      colour = "Method",
      shape = "DB family"
    ) +
    theme_bw()

  p_size_f1 <- q2_5_data |>
    ggplot(aes(x = db_size_mb, y = f1, colour = method, shape = db_base)) +
    geom_point(size = 2.5) +
    scale_x_log10() +
    labs(
      x = "DB size (MB, sintax file)",
      y = "Genus F1 (default settings)",
      colour = "Method",
      shape = "DB family"
    ) +
    theme_bw()

  fig_q2_5 <- p_size_time / p_size_f1 + patchwork::plot_layout(guides = "collect")
  print(fig_q2_5)
  save_fig(fig_q2_5, paste0("fig_q2_5_size_cost_", v$id), width = 8, height = 10)
})
```

## Q2.6 — Trimmed references (final zoom, OD 40)

Does trimming the references to the amplicon help? The final zoom (ROADMAP
0.11b, developer 2026-10-12) builds `fungi + rep cut` on the best source of
each provider on Pauvert, `EUK_ITS_v2.1` and `Unite_all_20250219`: the
`_Fungi` records cut with cutadapt between ITS1F and ITS2 (records without a
primer site kept whole, under the OD 32 cap), plus the untrimmed
representatives of the same source's `_Fungi_rep`
(`make_databases.R::derive_fungi_rep_cut()`). The two databases share one
representative draw and differ only by the cutting. ITS1F lies before the
start of almost every record, so the cut mostly removes the 5.8S end and
ITS2: the cut records keep ITS1 and the 5.8S start (median ~215 bp against
~520), close to the ITSx ITS1 queries. The representatives keep their whole
length (> 500 bp), hence the question of OD 16: are the k-mer methods drawn
to the longer records (`ext_fungi`, the share of the external controls named
Fungi at Kingdom)?

Project `assign_taxo_zoom` (`_targets.yaml`): the Pauvert ITS1 inputs, every
method and setting, on the two `_Fungi_rep` databases and their
`_Fungi_rep_cut`. Its `_Fungi_rep` columns repeat the main grid's on the same
input (same target names, so the same seeds) and must give chapter 01's
scores value for value, except that dada2 can flip a control sitting at its
bootstrap threshold between two runs (non-default thresholds only): the chunk
below stops on any other difference. ASVs, lead truth
rule; the zoom ran outside the timing conditions of M2.4, so its costs are
not read.

```{r q2-6-data}
#| include: false
source(here("R/mock_truth.R"))
source(here("R/score_assignments.R"))
source(here("R/assignment_helpers.R"))
store_zoom <- here("store_assign_taxo_zoom")
zoom_input <- "ITS1_asv"
zoom_ready <- !analysis_mini && assignments_complete(store_zoom, "ITS1", "asv")
```

```{r q2-6-missing, eval = !zoom_ready, results = "asis", echo = FALSE}
cat("The `assign_taxo_zoom` store is not built: run `run_project(\"assign_taxo_zoom\")` (`R/run_project.R`).\n")
```

```{r q2-6-score, eval = zoom_ready}
#| include: false
zoom_map <- build_values_map(dbs = zoom_grid_dbs, regions = "ITS1", units = "asv")
zoom_meta <- bind_rows(db_meta, zoom_db_meta)
input_of <- \(store) refseq(tar_read_raw(paste0("d_", zoom_input, "_for_assignation"), store = store))
stopifnot(
  "the zoom input differs from the main grid's" = identical(
    as.character(input_of(store_zoom)),
    as.character(input_of(store_assign_taxo))
  )
)
d_zoom <- tar_read_raw(paste0("d_all_taxo_", zoom_input), store = store_zoom) |>
  clean_taxo() |>
  add_gen_sp()
truth_zoom <- build_mock_truth(
  tar_read(d_asv, store = here("store_dada2")),
  mock_sanger_tables[mock_sanger_tables$dataset == "pauvert", ]
)
res_zoom <- score_truth_rules(
  d_zoom,
  build_ranks_df(d_zoom, zoom_map$full_name, ranks = tax_order),
  truth_zoom,
  zoom_meta,
  external_truth = external_control_truth(taxa_names(d_zoom)),
  truth_ranks = truth_ranks
) |>
  mutate(tax_level = ifelse(tax_level == "Species", "Gen_sp", tax_level)) |>
  left_join(
    transmute(
      zoom_map,
      method_db = full_name,
      algo = method,
      db,
      bootstrap_num = ifelse(method == "lca", NA_real_, min_bootstrap),
      lca_cutoff,
      vote_algorithm,
      min_id
    ),
    by = "method_db"
  ) |>
  left_join(zoom_meta, by = "db")

# The replica: the zoom's `_Fungi_rep` columns against chapter 01. dada2,
# rerun with the same target seed, can flip a control sitting at its
# bootstrap threshold (2026-10-12: one shuffled control at Kingdom in two
# columns at bootstrap 0.4 and 0.6), so its non-default columns may differ;
# any other difference stops the render.
zoom_replica <- res_zoom |>
  filter(simplification == "Fungi+rep") |>
  select(method_db, algo, bootstrap_num, tax_level, metrics, truth_rule, external_scoring, zoom = values) |>
  left_join(
    cache_read("res_comp_tax") |>
      filter(dataset == "pauvert", region == "ITS1", unit == "ASV") |>
      select(method_db, tax_level, metrics, truth_rule, external_scoring, main = values),
    by = c("method_db", "tax_level", "metrics", "truth_rule", "external_scoring")
  ) |>
  mutate(
    differs = is.na(zoom) != is.na(main) |
      (!is.na(zoom) & !is.na(main) & abs(zoom - main) > 1e-9)
  )
zoom_replica_off <- filter(zoom_replica, differs)
stopifnot(
  "the zoom _Fungi_rep columns differ from chapter 01 beyond dada2's non-default thresholds" = all(
    zoom_replica_off$algo == "dada2" & zoom_replica_off$bootstrap_num != 0.5
  )
)

# ext_fungi: external controls named Fungi at Kingdom, read from the
# assignment table (cleaned labels), as check_wood_vs_mock_rates.R does.
zoom_tt <- as.data.frame(as(tax_table(d_zoom), "matrix"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
is_external <- grepl("^external_", rownames(zoom_tt))
zoom_ext <- tibble::tibble(
  method_db = zoom_map$full_name,
  ext_fungi = vapply(
    paste0("Kingdom_", zoom_map$full_name),
    \(col) mean(zoom_tt[[col]][is_external] %in% "Fungi"),
    numeric(1)
  )
)

# Default settings, Genus: one row per source x method x database.
zoom_genus <- res_zoom |>
  filter(tax_level == "Genus", metrics %in% c("F1_score", "PPV", "NA_fake")) |>
  filter_default_settings() |>
  select(truth_rule, db_base, simplification, algo, method_db, metrics, values) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = metrics, values_from = values) |>
  left_join(zoom_ext, by = "method_db")
zoom_delta <- zoom_genus |>
  select(truth_rule, db_base, algo, simplification, F1_score, PPV, ext_fungi, NA_fake) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = simplification, values_from = c(F1_score, PPV, ext_fungi, NA_fake)) |>
  mutate(
    d_f1 = `F1_score_Fungi+rep+cut` - `F1_score_Fungi+rep`,
    d_ppv = `PPV_Fungi+rep+cut` - `PPV_Fungi+rep`,
    d_ext = `ext_fungi_Fungi+rep+cut` - `ext_fungi_Fungi+rep`
  )
# Paired intervals (OD 50): cut against uncut on the same units, per source
# x method and over the eight pairs.
zoom_default <- zoom_genus |>
  filter(truth_rule == lead_truth_rule) |>
  distinct(db_base, algo, simplification, method_db)
zoom_cells <- real_unit_cells(
  d_zoom,
  build_ranks_df(d_zoom, zoom_default$method_db, ranks = tax_order),
  truth_zoom,
  truth_ranks = truth_ranks,
  no_truth = truth_rules[[lead_truth_rule]]
) |>
  mutate(column = method_db, unit_id = taxon, group = taxon)
zoom_boot <- boot_view(zoom_cells)
zoom_col <- \(src, alg, simp) {
  zoom_default$method_db[
    zoom_default$db_base %in% src & zoom_default$algo %in% alg &
      zoom_default$simplification == simp
  ]
}
zoom_pairs <- distinct(zoom_default, db_base, algo)
zoom_intervals <- bind_rows(
  lapply(seq_len(nrow(zoom_pairs)), function(i) {
    boot_contrasts(zoom_boot, list(list(
      label = paste(zoom_pairs$db_base[i], zoom_pairs$algo[i]),
      a = zoom_col(zoom_pairs$db_base[i], zoom_pairs$algo[i], "Fungi+rep+cut"),
      b = zoom_col(zoom_pairs$db_base[i], zoom_pairs$algo[i], "Fungi+rep")
    )))
  }),
  boot_contrasts(zoom_boot, list(list(
    label = "all eight pairs",
    a = zoom_col(zoom_pairs$db_base, zoom_pairs$algo, "Fungi+rep+cut"),
    b = zoom_col(zoom_pairs$db_base, zoom_pairs$algo, "Fungi+rep")
  )))
)
zoom_all <- filter(zoom_intervals, contrast == "all eight pairs")
zoom_lead <- filter(zoom_delta, truth_rule == lead_truth_rule)
zoom_q2b <- filter(zoom_delta, truth_rule == "q2b")
zoom_kmer <- filter(zoom_lead, algo %in% c("dada2", "sintax"))
```

```{r q2-6-text, eval = zoom_ready, results = "asis", echo = FALSE}
cat(
  "Default settings, Genus, per source × method (", nrow(zoom_lead), " pairs). ",
  "**Cutting changes F1 by ", fmt_range(zoom_lead$d_f1), "** (",
  fmt_range(zoom_q2b$d_f1), " under `q2b`) and PPV by ",
  fmt_range(zoom_lead$d_ppv), ". Over the eight pairs (OD 50, 95 % paired bootstrap ",
  "interval): F1 ", with(filter(zoom_all, metric == "F1"), fmt_interval(delta, lo, hi)),
  ", PPV ", with(filter(zoom_all, metric == "PPV"), fmt_interval(delta, lo, hi)),
  "; the F1 interval of a single pair excludes 0 ",
  excludes_zero(filter(zoom_intervals, metric == "F1", contrast != "all eight pairs"), "pairs"),
  ". `ext_fungi` of the k-mer methods (dada2, sintax): ",
  fmt_range(zoom_kmer$`ext_fungi_Fungi+rep`), " on `fungi + rep`, ",
  fmt_range(zoom_kmer$`ext_fungi_Fungi+rep+cut`), " on `fungi + rep cut`; ",
  "of lca and blastn: change ",
  fmt_range(filter(zoom_lead, algo %in% c("lca", "blastn"))$d_ext), ". ",
  "The `_Fungi_rep` replica reproduces chapter 01 on ",
  sum(!zoom_replica$differs), " of ", nrow(zoom_replica), " rows; the others are ",
  n_distinct(zoom_replica_off$method_db), " dada2 columns at a non-default threshold, ",
  "where a control at the bootstrap edge flips between runs.\n\n",
  sep = ""
)
```

```{r q2-6-fig, eval = zoom_ready}
#| fig-height: 5
fig_q2_6_zoom <- zoom_genus |>
  filter(truth_rule == lead_truth_rule) |>
  select(db_base, algo, simplification, F1_score, ext_fungi) |>
  pivot_longer(c(F1_score, ext_fungi), names_to = "metric", values_to = "value") |>
  mutate(
    metric = factor(metric, levels = c("F1_score", "ext_fungi"), labels = c("Genus F1", "ext_fungi (controls named Fungi)")),
    simplification = factor(simplification, levels = c("Fungi+rep", "Fungi+rep+cut"))
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = simplification, y = value, colour = algo, group = algo)) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_line() +
  facet_grid(metric ~ db_base, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(x = "Database", y = NULL, colour = "Method") +
  theme_bw()
print(fig_q2_6_zoom)
save_fig(fig_q2_6_zoom, "fig_q2_6_zoom_cut", width = 8, height = 6)
```

```{r q2-6-table, eval = zoom_ready}
#| echo: false
zoom_lead |>
  transmute(
    Source = db_base,
    Method = algo,
    `F1 rep` = round(`F1_score_Fungi+rep`, 3),
    `F1 rep cut` = round(`F1_score_Fungi+rep+cut`, 3),
    `Δ F1 [95 %]` = with(
      filter(zoom_intervals, metric == "F1")[match(paste(db_base, algo), filter(zoom_intervals, metric == "F1")$contrast), ],
      fmt_interval(delta, lo, hi)
    ),
    `Δ F1 (q2b)` = round(zoom_q2b$d_f1[match(paste(db_base, algo), paste(zoom_q2b$db_base, zoom_q2b$algo))], 3),
    `PPV rep` = round(`PPV_Fungi+rep`, 3),
    `PPV rep cut` = round(`PPV_Fungi+rep+cut`, 3),
    `ext_fungi rep` = round(`ext_fungi_Fungi+rep`, 3),
    `ext_fungi rep cut` = round(`ext_fungi_Fungi+rep+cut`, 3),
    `fakes named rep / rep cut` = paste(round(1 - `NA_fake_Fungi+rep`, 3), "/", round(1 - `NA_fake_Fungi+rep+cut`, 3))
  ) |>
  arrange(Source, Method) |>
  knitr::kable(caption = "Pauvert ITS1 ASVs, Genus, default settings, lead truth rule (Δ also under q2b): fungi + rep against fungi + rep cut.")
```

## Under Q2b (OD 44)

Every section above reads the lead truth rule, `no_truth_aside`: the real
units without a truth (best hit 90–99.5 % to a mock member) leave the
scoring, so the chapter measures the assignment step, not how well the
sequencing represents the community. Under `q2b` they stay in it, wrong when
named and missed when left NA (chapter 01, OD 44).

```{r q2b-data}
#| include: false
s03_rule_rows <- function(rule) {
  view_rows(res_all, views, truth_rule = rule) |>
    filter(metrics == "F1_score", tax_level == "Genus") |>
    filter_default_settings() |>
    left_join(db_meta, by = "db")
}
s03_rules_db <- compare_truth_rules(function(rule) {
  s03_rule_rows(rule) |>
    group_by(view, db) |>
    summarise(value = mean(values), .groups = "drop")
}, "db")
s03_rules_source <- compare_truth_rules(function(rule) {
  s03_rule_rows(rule) |>
    group_by(view, db_base) |>
    summarise(value = mean(values), .groups = "drop") |>
    rename(source = db_base)
}, "source")
```

The best database at Genus `r rule_holds_phrase(s03_rules_db)`. The best
source `r rule_holds_phrase(s03_rules_source)`.

```{r q2b-table}
#| echo: false
knitr::kable(
  s03_rules_db$table,
  col.names = c("Database", names(s03_rules_db$table)[-1]),
  caption = "Genus F1 per database, default settings, mean over the four methods: no_truth_aside / q2b."
)
```
